company.name: SCS Softwares
company.positioning: Software agency offering transparent, hourly-billed development with an AI-assisted preliminary estimate before any commitment.

services.name: Web Development
services.summary: Websites and web applications, typically React frontends with Node.js APIs and PostgreSQL.

services.name: Mobile App Development
services.summary: Cross-platform mobile apps, typically React Native with a Node.js API backend.

services.name: UI/UX Design
services.summary: Wireframes, UI screens and design systems ahead of development.

services.name: Cloud Solutions
services.summary: Cloud architecture, hosting and scaling for web and mobile products.

services.name: DevOps Services
services.summary: CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation and infrastructure operations.

services.name: Digital Marketing
services.summary: Marketing services for launched digital products.

services.name: Project Rescue & Completion
services.summary: Audit, stabilisation and completion of broken or unfinished projects, starting with a short code audit.

engagementProcess: Share your requirement with Buddy or the project-analysis form.
Receive a preliminary estimate with roles, hours and a cost range.
A consultant reviews the requirement on a free review call.
You receive a confirmed quote and sprint plan within 2 business days of the review call.
Development runs in weekly cycles with demo builds every week.
benefits: Transparent hourly pricing — you approve every hour before work starts
You see an estimated team, cost and timeline before committing
Dedicated project manager and weekly demo calls
NDA and full source-code ownership from day one
Post-launch support window included in every engagement

hourlyEngagementModel.description: Work is billed by the hour per role at transparent rates. Example published rates: UI/UX design from $10/hr, frontend from $15/hr, backend from $20/hr. Final rates are confirmed on the review call.
hourlyEngagementModel.minimumEngagementNote: No minimum-hours rule is published; do not claim one.

weeklyCapacity.explanation: Delivery duration is projected by dividing total estimated hours by a standard 40-hour weekly team capacity. Faster delivery may be possible with a larger team, confirmed during review.

humanReviewProcess: Every preliminary estimate is reviewed by an SCS Softwares consultant before any final quotation. Visitors can request a human review of their estimate at any time; a consultant then confirms scope, cost and timeline — a preliminary estimate is never a final quote.
prohibitedClaims: That a preliminary estimate is a final quotation
That a developer has been assigned
That the project has been approved
That SCS guarantees any particular business result
Any client names, testimonials, certifications, team size or delivery-date guarantees
